description: A principal must decide whether a student may represent the school at a regional robotics competition after an academic-integrity referral and must finalize the student's team role, corrective work, and family conference arrangements, with input from the robotics coach and school counselor.

shared_context.S1: A student on the school robotics team has been referred for an academic-integrity violation involving the team's design log.
shared_context.S2: The regional competition is in two weeks, and the principal must approve the student's participation and finalize any corrective plan.
shared_context.S3: The school normally uses a documented corrective response for student-activity integrity violations rather than leaving the response informal.
shared_context.S4: The principal's routine review requires the robotics coach and school counselor to report relevant operational and student-support information before the decision is recorded.

PF1.text: Ms. Ibarra reviewed the design-log history and the robotics conduct rubric: this is the student's first minor violation, and the rubric permits competition participation if the student is assigned the documentation-auditor role, completes a 2-hour integrity workshop, and has the corrective assignment recorded.

PF2.text: Mr. Lewis confirmed with the family that the required conference can occur virtually on Tuesday at 6:00 p.m., with a Spanish interpreter; the family cannot attend an in-person meeting.

acceptance_conditions: The student must remain eligible to participate in the regional competition.
The student must be assigned the documentation-auditor team role.
The student must complete exactly 2 hours of integrity training.
The corrective assignment must be formally recorded.
The family conference must be virtual on Tuesday at 6:00 p.m. with a Spanish interpreter.
The participation decision must cite the robotics coach's documented conduct-rubric finding.

content_checks.C5: decisions['family_conference_format'] == 'virtual' and decisions['family_conference_day'] == 'Tuesday' and decisions['family_conference_time'] == '6:00 p.m.' and decisions['interpreter_language'] == 'Spanish'

decisive_facts.why: The first-minor-violation rubric finding changes the outcome from an unspecified or exclusionary response to eligibility with the exact documentation-auditor role, exactly 2 workshop hours, and a required recorded corrective assignment.

The family's confirmed arrangement changes the conference from an unspecified meeting to a virtual Tuesday meeting at exactly 6:00 p.m. with a Spanish interpreter and requires a family-conference commitment.
